description: Welcome to the only major-chain beachfront hotel in the Gulf Shores, Alabama. Located on the white-sand shores of one of America's most beautiful beaches, the Best Western on the Beach is your tropical vacation destination, offering all the comforts of home with exceptional value for your dollar. Marvel at uninterrupted views of the Gulf of Mexico from your private balcony. Relax on a plush, pillow-top bed. Stay connected with free high-speed wireless Internet. Catch a flick on a 42" flatscreen TV. At the Best Western on the Beach, our clean, modern Gulf Shores accommodations offer all the comforts of home and all the beauty of the beach at rates that will leave you with plenty to spend on the area's world-class attractions.
